preconditions.description: Input is a list of exactly three rounds.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round, list) and len(round) == 2 for round in x)
preconditions.description: Each round is a list of exactly two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round[0], dict) and 'P1' in round[0] and 'P2' in round[0] for round in x)
preconditions.description: Each round's first element is a dictionary with keys 'P1' and 'P2'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round[0]['P1'], str) and isinstance(round[0]['P2'], str) for round in x)
preconditions.description: Each player's score in a round is a string.

preconditions.expression: all(all(char in 'XO' for char in round[0]['P1']) for round in x)
preconditions.description: Each character in Pete's score string is either 'X' or 'O'.

preconditions.expression: all(all(char in 'XO' for char in round[0]['P2']) for round in x)
preconditions.description: Each character in Phil's score string is either 'X' or 'O'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round[1], bool) for round in x)
preconditions.description: Each round's second element is a boolean.

postconditions.description: The output is one of 'Pete Wins!', 'Phil Wins!', or 'Draw!'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Pete Wins!' if sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P1'].count('X') for round in x) > sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P2'].count('X') for round in x) else True
postconditions.description: The output is 'Pete Wins!' if Pete's total score is greater than Phil's total score.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Phil Wins!' if sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P2'].count('X') for round in x) > sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P1'].count('X') for round in x) else True
postconditions.description: The output is 'Phil Wins!' if Phil's total score is greater than Pete's total score.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Draw!' if sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P1'].count('X') for round in x) == sum((2 if round[1] else 1) * round[0]['P2'].count('X') for round in x) else True
postconditions.description: The output is 'Draw!' if Pete's total score is equal to Phil's total score.
